title: Evaluation of a Complementary Navigation Filter Steering a UAS Autopilot in a GNSS Contested Environment
authors: Appleget A.; Watson J.; Gray J.; Leishman R.C.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
